The '''Wizard's Breadcrumbs''' are a {{Rare}} item obtained from {{NPCSprite|Wizard But Weird}}.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Wizard's Breadcrumbs''' can be purchased by speaking to the {{NPCSprite|Wizard But Weird}} in the {{Zone|Wizard Tower (Rift)}}.

== Usage ==
The '''Wizard's Breadcrumbs''' can be used to show the player yellow particles that lead back to the {{Zone|Wizard Tower (Rift)}}. Fully using it and arriving at the tower will remove it from the player's inventory and allow them to unlock the [[Rift Guide]].
